name: Dialog
description: A popup as a dialog the visitor opens: a button in a section of the page and a modal <dialog> with a heading, text and buttons. Never opens by itself. Focus is trapped inside and returns to the button, Escape closes it; the button opens it with no script where Invoker Commands exist, a small script covers other browsers and closes on a backdrop click, and with scripting off the content is laid out in the section itself.

triggerStyle.description: How the opening button looks: a filled or outlined button, or a text link.

size.description: Width of the dialog: 28, 40 or 56 rem (never wider than the screen).

align.description: Where the button sits in the section; the measured align when not set.

triggerLabel.label: Button text
triggerLabel.description: Text of the button that opens the dialog (the popup's trigger link or button).

heading.label: Heading
heading.description: The dialog's title; it names the dialog for screen readers.

html.label: Text
html.description: The popup's content as rendered HTML (the popup template's text).

actions.label: Buttons

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the button goes: a page on this site or a full address.

newTab.label: Open in a new tab
newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab (an external site the reader should not leave for).

style.label: Style
style.description: primary for the main action, secondary or ghost for the ones beside it.

actions.description: The popup's own buttons, under its text, in order; none by default.

id.description: Unique on the page: the button points at the dialog by it.

closeLabel.description: Accessible name of the close button (ui-strings dialog.close).

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

open.description: Rendered already open, in the flow of the section and not modal: for previews and visual baselines only, never for a page.

a11y: A native modal <dialog> (the APG dialog pattern as the platform implements it): focus moves in and stays in, the page behind is inert, Escape closes and focus returns to the button. The heading names it (aria-labelledby; the button text when there is no heading). The close button is named by closeLabel. Nothing opens on load, on scroll or on exit intent; the text is in the HTML, so crawlers read it, and with scripting off it is shown in the section as a plain block, so nothing is hidden or blocks the page.
